issues.title: Relay priced ~20.6 bps below relay.link on every EVM → Solana route
issues.detail: Bridg's Relay row is 25.6 bps under relay.link on ETH→SOL, BSC→SOL and Base→SOL in every sample; 5 bps is Bridg's own fee, leaving ~0.21 USDC more 'Relay fee'. Solana-source routes match. Hypothesis (unverified): Bridg's quote includes Solana USDC token-account rent that relay.link omits when no recipient wallet is set.

issues.title: Across missing from Bridg on 4 of 6 routes
issues.detail: Not listed on ETH→SOL, BSC→SOL, Base→SOL or SOL→BSC although across.to quotes 99.98–99.99. Where listed (SOL→ETH, SOL→Base) it matches exactly net of Bridg's fee.

issues.title: LI.FI row 45–97 bps below jumper.exchange
issues.detail: Bridg's 'Lifi' quote is below Jumper's Best Return on every route; one Bridg breakdown showed 'Lifi fee 1.0167 USDC'. Jumper often routes via Relay or Polymer. Hypothesis (unverified): a different LI.FI route or an integrator fee in Bridg's LI.FI request.

issues.title: deBridge fixed fee is charged on top of the input on its own site
issues.detail: app.debridge.finance adds a 1.05–2.58 USDC fee on top of the 100 input; Bridg deducts it from output. Compared on the same basis (direct out − fixed fee), deBridge matches — and Bridg appears not to take its 5 bps on deBridge.

issues.title: Jumper displayed 120.36 USDC out for 100 in (BSC→SOL, sample 2)
issues.detail: Mayan (Swift) route on jumper.exchange; screenshot receipt kept, value excluded from averages.

issues.title: Across UI input stays disabled on BSC→SOL in ~half of loads
issues.detail: Only 2 good samples for Across on BSC→SOL.

issues.title: BSC 'USDC' is Binance-Peg USDC everywhere
issues.detail: 0x8AC76a51cc950d9822D68b83fE1Ad97B32Cd580d, 18 decimals — bridged, not native Circle USDC. Every site including Bridg used this contract.

issues.title: Mayan shows 2–4 decimal places and moves between quotes
issues.detail: Dutch-auction (Swift) pricing; sub-bp comparisons on Mayan are not meaningful. Bridg tags Mayan as 'Compare only' (not executable via Bridg).
